description: Get a random cat image matching a specific tag (e.g., 'orange', 'cute', 'sleepy'). Returns image URL, cat ID, and tags.

tag.description: Tag to filter cats by (e.g. "cute", "orange", "grumpy"). Use list_tags to see available tags.

name: cat_by_tag

created_at.description: ISO timestamp when cat image was created

id.description: Unique identifier for the cat image

mimetype.description: MIME type of the image file

searched_tag.description: The tag that was searched for

tags.description: Array of tags associated with the cat

url.description: Direct URL to the cat image

title: Cat By Tag
